nodes.label: QuantumQA: Enhancing Scientific Reasoning via Physics-Consistent Dataset and Verification-Aware RL
nodes.author: Songxin Qu et al.

nodes.label: QuantumQA Dataset (92,749 hybrid-verified samples)
nodes.rationale: Uses a two-layer verification protocol (symbolic SES + independent LLM critic + human audit) so mathematically fluent but physically wrong responses are caught.

nodes.label: Verification-Aware Reward Model (VRM)
nodes.rationale: Keeps mathematical correctness, physical consistency, and instruction-following as separate reward signals with learned per-instance fusion weighting, because collapsing scientific correctness into one pass/fail signal is too coarse for problems that can be right on some axes and wrong on others.
